name: cutroom
description: A lightweight, local desktop video editor.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node tests/e2e/smoke.mjs && node tests/e2e/smart.mjs && node tests/e2e/audio.mjs && node tests/e2e/photo.mjs && node tests/e2e/titles.mjs && node tests/e2e/export.mjs && node tests/e2e/speed.mjs && node tests/e2e/transitions.mjs && node tests/e2e/color.mjs && node tests/e2e/shortcuts.mjs && node tests/e2e/formats.mjs && node tests/e2e/overlays.mjs && node tests/e2e/editing.mjs && node tests/e2e/motion.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && node tests/e2e/mcp.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cutroom records voice-overs from your microphone when you ask it to.
